prompt: When does the instructor say the test bench is open?
promptZh: 講師說測試檯何時開放？

options.whyZh: 講師所說開放時間在課程內，不是課前。

options.text: During the last half of class
options.whyZh: 後半段與 first half 相反。
訊息沒有說測試檯在下課後使用。

options.text: During the first half of class
options.whyZh: 講師直接說 during the first half of the class。

explanationZh: 講師直接說 during the first half of the class。
evidence:
Document 2 · Instructor’s message
The test bench will be open during the first half of the class. If your unlabelled cloth needs more tests, you can still take part by using one of the cotton practice squares at the bench. The squares are already washed. Do not borrow someone else’s label or guess the fibre from how it feels.

vocabulary.note: first half 指一段時間的前半段，不一定是從某個整點開始。
